profile.onboarding: Wordless; the player taps where to walk and glowing handles show what can be moved.
profile.controls: Tap to walk, drag to rotate or slide parts of the world.
profile.core_loop: Reshape the world so the path connects, then walk to the goal.
profile.goals_and_rewards: Reaching the goal triggers a beautiful visual reveal each chapter.
profile.difficulty_curve: Very smooth, introducing one new idea per chapter.
profile.game_feel: Calm and tactile, with musical feedback on every drag.
profile.art_and_audio: Pastel art with ambient music and no voice-over.
profile.session_length: About 10-15 minutes per chapter, with natural stopping points.
profile.usability: No fail state at all, with interactive parts clearly highlighted.
profile.accessibility: No reading required and no time pressure.
profile.ads_and_purchases: Paid up-front, with a paid expansion.
profile.notes: General knowledge only, not played this session; useful mainly as a contrast for onboarding and failure design rather than genre fit.
